value.rationale: The defect-deletion filtration is canonical and topologically nontrivial: exact group ranks do not determine persistence maps. This result supplies a complete, all-size, all-field barcode and integral primitive coherent generators, distinguishes simultaneous death from cumulative birth, and is useful for further edge-perturbation persistence comparisons. It is a mathematically motivated functorial enhancement, not an unmotivated single parameter computation.
